summon.text: The Brain of Cthulhu spawns upon destroying every third Crimson Heart in a Crimson world. It can also be summoned manually by using a Bloody Spine in The Crimson or Underground Crimson, at any time.

suggestedEquipment.note: Of the two whips this tip names, only the Snapthorn is verified as obtainable before this fight.

prepChecklist.text: Set up rows of platforms across the Chasm's central chamber and light it up
Block off the entrances of nearby chambers so enemies can't enter
Place Peace Candles or drink a Calming Potion before the fight
Using a Bloody Spine: keep a surface arena low so you stay in the Crimson
Drink Ironskin, Swiftness and Regeneration Potions
Equip a Cloud in a Bottle for a double jump
Wear Hermes Boots for speed
Carry a stack of the best healing potion you have

strategies.text: Brain of Cthulhu has 2 phases, with the latter starting after all Creepers have been dealt with.
Jump out of the way, either by using your platforms or with an extra jump, then attack the Creepers. Use piercing weapons to speed up the process.
Creepers have low individual health and are especially susceptible to the On Fire! and Frostburn debuffs.

When all of the Creepers are dead, the Brain will split, revealing a Heart with an Eye on the inside. The Brain teleports much more frequently, often at unexpected angles, and will try to ram into you.
If you have a weapon with high knockback, it will excel at dealing with the Brain, so much so that it's possible to stand in one location and attack it whenever it gets close.
During the second phase, the Brain will spawn clones of itself around the player.
Life-draining debuffs such as On Fire! and Frostburn will help distinguish them. Additionally, summoned minions and sentries will always target the correct copy.
The real Brain is the only one with a health bar.
A spear is a good weapon against the Brain of Cthulhu during the second stage.
A flail of some kind is beneficial for taking out the Creepers; the easiest to obtain would be the Flaming Mace (craftable from a Mace, which can be found in Gold Chests located underground).
Tendon Bow is an easily obtainable and powerful bow at this stage.
You can combine them with either Unholy Arrows or Jester's Arrows, which greatly help to kill the swarm of Creepers.
The Crimson Rod is a great support weapon that can easily be obtained through Crimson Hearts.
A Diamond Staff is very good at taking out the Creepers because of its high fire rate, large hitbox and pierce.
If the Snapthorn is too difficult to obtain, one can use the Vasculash, which is a weaker alternative.
The summon tag icon will linger on the correct Brain, which may be helpful in identifying the correct copy.

summon.text: Deerclops can be summoned manually by using a Deer Thing in the Snow or Ice biome, at any time.

suggestedEquipment.note: Of the three guns this tip names, only the Minishark is verified as obtainable before this fight.

prepChecklist.text: Clear a large flat area in the Snow biome
Set your spawn point away from where Deerclops can wander
Drink a Warmth Potion: its buff cuts Deerclops's damage by 30%
Equip a Hand Warmer against the Frozen debuff
Drink Ironskin, Endurance and Regeneration Potions
Drink a Swiftness Potion to help dodge
Equip a Cloud in a Bottle (or a better jump accessory)
Carry a stack of the best healing potion you have

strategies.text: Avoid lingering directly above Deerclops, as the Shadow Hands it summons in this situation are very dangerous.
The player can run between Deerclops's legs without taking damage. This is useful for avoiding the first two Ice Spike attacks, but the player should not stick around for the third.

If it is close to the player, Deerclops will smash the ground, summoning a wave of Ice Spikes that quickly travels towards the player. Every third consecutive wave does not go as far, instead spreading in both directions.

If the player is more than 30 tiles away, Deerclops will turn a dark shade of purple, two reddish, semi-transparent images of Deerclops will begin spinning around it, and it becomes immune to all damage.
Due to being able to inflict Slow from a large range, accessories like the Anklet of the Wind or Magiluminescence alongside Swiftness Potions can help make the fight much more manageable.
The Frozen debuff from the Ice Spike attack is capable of interrupting a player's extending grappling hook, causing them to drop to the ground.
Shadow Hands are summoned more frequently as Deerclops's life gets lower. Shadow Hands predict the player's movements.
The Flamarang can deal very high damage to Deerclops at a safer distance than most swords.
The Terragrim performs excellently if acquired, especially if you stand under Deerclops and swing up towards his torso.
The Demon or Tendon Bow can be used for players who find it hard to obtain other weapons.
The Musket or The Undertaker are decent and the Minishark can also be used.
The Vilethorn is a solid choice, especially due to Deerclops's low defense.
The Space Gun is a good weapon, especially when combined with Meteor armor.
Sentry weapons like the Ballista Rod and Explosive Trap Rod are more viable on Deerclops than other bosses due to it slow speed and large body.
The Snapthorn is the best whip when using most minions against Deerclops.

summon.text: Duke Fishron is summoned by fishing in the Ocean at any time, using a Truffle Worm as bait

suggestedEquipment.note: Of the weapons this tip names, the Firecracker and the Snapthorn are verified as obtainable before this fight.

prepChecklist.text: Build the arena over the Ocean: away from it he enrages
Stack 3–5 rows of platforms about 50 tiles apart: the tornadoes are tall
Find a Truffle Worm in the underground Glowing Mushroom biome
Drink an Inferno Potion to destroy his Detonating Bubbles
Bring fast wings: quick aerial movement is a must
Drink Regeneration, Ironskin, Endurance and Lifeforce Potions
No platform over the water? Drink Water Walking Potions
Carry a stack of the best healing potion you have

strategies.text: Duke Fishron's charges aim for where the player is, not where they will be. Because of this, moving perpendicularly with his charges will cause him to completely miss.
Also, note that Duke Fishron's first attack will always be bubbles.
Do not fly all the way into the space layer, or the reduced gravity will render you helpless.
Once the bubble strikes the player, they should do all they can to quickly move, to prevent the Cthulhunado from spawning on top of them.
Contact with a Cthulhunado, either immediately after its spawning or later, should be avoided by all possible means, as they deal 100 contact damage.
Though his difficulty makes him a post-Plantera or Golem boss, it is possible to defeat him before the mechanical bosses.
When Duke Fishron drops below 15% health, he will transform again and the background will notably darken, while making himself invisible except for his glowing eyes.
As there won't be many opportunities to deal damage, you should try to deal as much burst damage as possible during his charges.
In Expert Mode, the Shield of Cthulhu can be used to great effect, providing brief invincibility frames when dashing into him.
The Terra Blade scales with melee speed as well as damage and critical chance, and its large projectile makes hitting Duke Fishron and the Detonating Bubbles easy.

The Bananarang and Chain Guillotines are the best options against this boss before any mechanical bosses with the former being better in the second phase and the latter being better at fighting him at a close range.
The Daedalus Stormbow with Ichor Arrows is the best ranged option for dispatching Duke before defeating any other Hardmode boss.
Ichor Arrows, Bullets, or Darts will reduce his defense significantly, since he is vulnerable to Ichor.

The Spirit Flame, Crystal Serpent, Orange Zapinator, Lightning Strike, Rainbow Rod, and Unholy Trident are the best pre-Plantera magic weapons against this boss, with the former four being available at the start of Hardmode.
The Golden Shower spellbook is helpful as it reduces his defense and easily pops all the Detonating Bubbles.

If you are fighting the boss at an early stage, the Sanguine Staff paired with Firecracker and Snapthorn (or Durendal if you have defeated at least one mechanical boss) is the best weapon pre-Plantera.
While most sentries are unable to hit this boss effectively, the Barnacle Staff can float in the air over the ocean.

summon.text: The Eater of Worlds spawns upon destroying every third Shadow Orb in a Corruption world. It can also be summoned manually by using a Worm Food in The Corruption or Underground Corruption, at any time.

prepChecklist.text: Classic Mode: build a tall, thin surface arena that is easy to climb, with many platforms
Keep the arena low enough that the Corruption background stays visible
If breaking Shadow Orbs, prepare a quick, safe escape to your surface arena
Place a Bed next to the arena so you can teleport there
Hang an Eater of Souls Banner to reduce their damage
Drink Ironskin and Regeneration Potions
Drink a Hunter Potion to spot it while it burrows
Carry a stack of the best healing potion you have

strategies.text: Beware that, when a segment dies, the segments in front and behind will detach and separately attack the player.
To avoid getting overwhelmed by many worms at once, it may be helpful to only aim for the head or tail of the worm, as these segments will not cause the boss to split further when killed.
If you destroy a middle segment, concentrate on the smaller worm, since the larger one can be easy to predict and dodge.

Like other worm enemies, once the Eater's head passes a given point, every body segment must follow. This allows the player to stand next to the body, attacking every segment as it goes by. The player should be wary of the head looping back around.
In Classic Mode, Grenades are an effective weapon against the Eater. That is not true in higher difficulties, since the Eater gains resistance to explosives.
The Eater of Worlds will start to flee underground if the player leaves the Corruption biome, but will not immediately despawn.
Vile Spit is the Eater of Worlds' most dangerous attack, so it is important to bring sufficient mobility accessories and make an arena that enables you to dodge.
Broadswords do very well against this boss.
Spears such as the Swordfish can damage multiple segments at once, and are most effective if you try to line them up with the boss's length.
Jester's Arrows can pierce through infinitely many segments, although the damage drops each segment.
The Demon Bow is easily available and powerful.
The Vilethorn is good for spreading damage across the boss's entire body.
Topaz's small explosion is very helpful in this fight, shredding through segments of the boss.
The Flinx Staff is consistently available and can damage a lot of segments at once if spread out.
Pairing 1 Vampire Frog and 2 Flinx will grant the most DPS available for summoners.

summon.text: The Empress of Light is summoned by killing a Prismatic Lacewing, at any time. Prismatic Lacewings spawn in The Hallow on the Surface between dusk (7:30 PM) and midnight (12:00 AM) once Plantera has been defeated.

suggestedEquipment.note: Of the weapons this general tip names, only the Scourge of the Corruptor is a melee weapon verified as obtainable before this fight, in Corruption worlds only.

prepChecklist.text: Fight her at night: by day her attacks kill in one hit
Catch a Prismatic Lacewing with a Bug Net to pick when and where to fight
Build a wide arena with 3–5 rows of platforms, 15–25 tiles apart
Equip wings, or bring a mount
Drink Lifeforce, Ironskin, Regeneration and Endurance Potions
Drink a Wrath Potion and a Rage Potion for damage
At night, a Cross Necklace or Star Veil helps against rapid hits
Carry a stack of the best healing potion you have

strategies.text: These bolts do not have perfect tracking, and will miss if the player makes a sharp turn as they approach.
When the Empress of Light initiates a charge, it is advised that you go downwards, as often the charge crosses the player's position if the same height is kept.

It is best to stay at an average level or below the Empress of Light as she zips above the player's position after every attack she does, making it more likely for the player to be killed by contact damage during the day or take unnecessary hits during the night.

Ethereal Lance is the only move the Empress of Light can use to attack the player regardless of distance since the Ethereal Lances appear near the player's position instead of traveling from the Empress of Light to the player.
A Rod of Discord will help the player evade some of the Empress of Light's attacks.

Use weapons that are capable of dealing damage reliably from long range or have homing, such as the Blizzard Staff, Possessed Hatchet, Scourge of the Corruptor, Tsunami, Aerial Bane, Snowman Cannon, Chain Gun, or Tactical Shotgun with Chlorophyte Bullets.
In Expert mode or higher, the Empress of Light follows the same pattern of attacks as in her enraged state.
The Influx Waver, Terra Blade and the Flying Dragon are the best swords available, having strong reliable projectiles.
The Flairon is also viable thanks to its good damage and homing capabilities.
The Tsunami is a very strong option with great accuracy and power when using Ichor Arrows or Venom Arrows.
The Xenopopper is the strongest gun available pre-Cultist, with very high damage and good accuracy.
The Blizzard Staff is a very good choice due to its consistent and high DPS.

The Spectre Staff doesn't deal as much damage as other options but can be obtained without fighting any Bosses or Events, making it a good choice for fighting the Empress of Light immediately after Plantera.
The Desert Tiger Staff is the best option before defeating Golem. It should be used with the Vulgar Display of Flower whip.
The Xeno Staff's High DPS and accuracy makes it the best option against the Empress of Light.

summon.text: The Eye of Cthulhu can be summoned manually using a Suspicious Looking Eye at night (from 7:30 PM to 4:30 AM).

prepChecklist.text: Build a screen-sized arena with several rows of wooden platforms
Light the arena with Torches: the fight is at night
Place Campfires and Heart Lanterns in the arena for health regeneration
Summon it just after dusk (7:30 PM) for the most time before dawn
Drink Regeneration, Ironskin and Swiftness Potions
Wear Hermes Boots (or equivalents) to dodge the second phase's rams
Bring a Cloud in a Bottle (or equivalent) to avoid the rams
Carry a stack of the best healing potion you have

strategies.text: After spawning 3 or 4 Servants, the Eye will charge at you, attempting to ram you 3 times before hovering once more, so be prepared to evade.
It can be helpful to begin to evade after the 3rd servant is spawned, as this will often allow you to dodge its first charge.
The Servants are weak and can be killed for Hearts, or, if there is enough room, the player can simply keep moving in one direction to avoid them.
Make sure to take advantage of its transformation sequence as much as possible, since it just spins in place for a few moments and you can still damage it.
For the last half of the fight, the boss sheds its iris to reveal a fanged mouth. It moves slightly faster and deals more damage when it hits you, but it also has no defense.
With a wide enough arena, running in a straight line while the Eye of Cthulhu does his quick charge is fast enough to avoid any damage, and allows the player to attack continuously.
The boss looks at the player it will follow, which can be helpful information in multiplayer.
In the first phase of the fight it spawns more servants and enters the second phase at 65% health instead of 50%, spawning 4–5 more Servants in that process.
In this part of the fight, after the 3 normal lunges it will perform a brief series of extremely quick dashes at a steeper angle.
Long-range projectile swords can safely attack at a distance.
Yoyos have good range and allow for fine control.
Bows are easy to craft and do good damage.
Frostburn Arrows deal the most damage to the boss itself and inflict Frostburn, but Jester's Arrows can kill the Servants and hurt the Eye in the same shot.
The Wand of Frosting is relatively easy to obtain and inflicts the strong Frostburn debuff.
The Crimson Rod is an excellent side-weapon, as its clouds can be set up to clear out the servants while also dealing steady damage to the boss.
The Cobwhip is the easiest whip to obtain at this point in the game, although it is weaker than other options.
Two somewhat stronger options are Leather Whip, which can be bought from the Zoologist NPC, and the Slime Whip, which can be crafted at a Solidifier.

summon.text: Golem is summoned by using a Lihzahrd Power Cell at the Lihzahrd Altar located in the final chamber of the Jungle Temple, at any time, and only if the current world is in Hardmode after Plantera is defeated.

suggestedEquipment.note: Of the weapons this tip names, only the Leaf Blower is verified as obtainable before this fight.
Verified as obtainable before this fight in Corruption worlds only.

prepChecklist.text: Place a row of platforms 25–30 blocks above the floor: Golem can't jump that high
Fighting in the temple? Hang Lihzahrd and Flying Snake Banners
Stay in the Underground Jungle: outside it Golem enrages
Drink an Obsidian Skin Potion so its fireballs can't set you on fire
Drink Ironskin, Endurance, Regeneration and Lifeforce Potions
Bring Jungle Juice, or Greater Healing Potions
Equip wings: the fight fills the arena with projectiles
Equip a Frozen Shield for knockback immunity

strategies.text: Dodging the fireballs is your priority, as they will inflict On Fire! and prevent health regeneration.
Destroying the arms is not strictly necessary, but recommended to make the next phase much easier.
The lasers signal a DPS race and all focus should be concentrated on getting through each laser phase.
These eye lasers can pass through blocks.
A blocked line of sight increases the Eye Beam's damage by 50% and their velocity by 150%.
Golem's movement is slowed down drastically when submerged in honey.
The only difference in these modes are increased damage and increased health.
Terra Blade is usually the best weapon for Golem, especially when using the blade itself to damage the fists.
Scourge of the Corruptor is also extremely useful as it does good damage, splits into three and is homing.
Venus Magnum coupled with Crystal Bullets is also a great weapon.
The Stake Launcher and Candy Corn Rifle excel in this fight.
The Spectre Staff, Leaf Blower and Inferno Fork are the usually the best magic weapons for Golem.
Golden Shower is the best support magic weapon as it gives +15 armor penetration.
The Desert Tiger Staff does excellent damage against Golem when combined with the Vulgar Display of Flower whip.
The Raven Staff is amazing for this fight, as the ravens can easily stay on top of Golem thanks to its slow movement.

summon.text: King Slime can be summoned by using the Slime Crown, in any biome at any time.

suggestedEquipment.note: Of the two weapons this tip names, only the Flinx Staff is verified as obtainable before this fight.

prepChecklist.text: Build one or two long rows of platforms above the ground
Place Campfires and Heart Lanterns in the arena for health regeneration
Hang a Blue Slime Banner for its offensive and defensive buffs
Bring a long-range weapon to keep a safe distance from his contact damage
Drink Ironskin and Regeneration Potions
Drink a Swiftness Potion for mobility
Equip a double-jump accessory such as a Cloud in a Bottle
Carry a stack of the best healing potion you have

strategies.text: The pattern of his jumps is predictable and repeatedly: two normal, one small, and one high.
After the high jump, the King Slime can teleport to the player.
When King Slime is about to teleport, he shrinks, and his map icon will get closer to the ground.
Getting too far away from King Slime will make it teleport to the player, meaning that the player cannot escape by simply running offscreen.
King Slime becomes smaller and faster the lower his health is, which makes him harder to hit.
Piercing weapons can not only damage King Slime, but also kill the additional slimes he spawns.
If he or his slimes reach the platform, drop down temporarily and use hooks or double-jumps to return; this will cause King Slime and his minions to drop down as well, following you.
King Slime is very slow in liquids.
However, when damaged it will spawn Spiked Slimes in addition to regular Blue Slimes.
The Thorn Chakram is a good option to keep the boss at range, but can struggle against the hordes of slimes.
The Ice Blade is a weaker option that is easier to obtain.
A cheap and powerful option is a bow, such as the Gold, Platinum, or even the Tendon/Demon Bow.
Frostburn Arrows or Jester's Arrows are the preferred ammo types, due to the high single target damage of the former and the piercing effect of the latter.
The Emerald Staff and all stronger staves do well against King Slime.
The Wand of Frosting is an easily obtained magic weapon that does well in this fight.
The best multiple-use summon weapons at this part of the game are the Flinx Staff and the Vampire Frog Staff.
The Soulscourge and Vasculash are weaker yet easier to obtain alternatives, only requiring mining Demonite or Crimtane.

summon.text: The Lunatic Cultist is summoned after killing the Cultists that spawn at the Dungeon's entrance after Skeletron and Golem have been defeated.

suggestedEquipment.note: Of the two weapons this tip names, only the Possessed Hatchet is verified as obtainable before this fight.

prepChecklist.text: Build a basic arena with a few rows of platforms near the Dungeon (a Skeletron arena works)
Be ready for the Lunar Events: defeating it starts them at once
Fight at night: the decoy cultists glow
Drink a Hunter Potion to spot the real Cultist among its clones
Drink Regeneration, Endurance, Lifeforce and Ironskin Potions
Drink a Swiftness Potion for mobility
Equip a Frozen Shield for knockback immunity and less damage taken
Afterwards, keep a Magic Mirror or Recall Potion ready in case a Celestial Pillar spawns nearby
Carry a stack of the best healing potion you have

strategies.text: If the real Lunatic Cultist is damaged, neither of these two powerful minions will spawn in.
When the ritual starts, the real Cultist is the copy that is furthest away from the player.
When hovered over, decoys will always display as having 10000/10000 health, while the real Cultist will display its true health value instead.
Using Autopause grants as much time as needed for identifying the real Cultist.
Many of the Lunatic Cultist's attacks can be blocked by hiding behind solid blocks, including its lightning bolts and fireballs.
By remain very close to the boss and slowly circling him using a flying mount, the attacks are closer together and easier to dodge.
In Expert Mode, when the health of the boss is below 50%, the Cultist may also spawn Ancient Dooms that fire purple projectiles in a cross shape.
The Paladin's Hammer has high damage and quick attacks, while the Possessed Hatchet trades some power for a homing effect.
The Kraken is the best yoyo at this stage, which deals high damage and will help with taking out the Lunatic Cultist and the Phantasm Dragon he summons.
The Xenopopper with Nano Bullets is the strongest gun available.
The Snowman Cannon is the best launcher available, which is very useful with its homing high damaging projectiles.
The Nightglow is a very strong weapon with high damage and requires no aiming.
Magnet Sphere will do a lot of damage, and can be used in combination with other weapons.
The Terraprisma is the strongest minion available, though you will have to face the monumental task of beating Empress of Light during the day.
The Ballista Staff is the strongest sentry available.

summon.text: The Moon Lord will spawn after destroying the four Celestial Pillars or can be summoned manually using a Celestial Sigil in any world where Golem has been defeated.

suggestedEquipment.note: Of the four whips this tip names, these two are verified as obtainable before this fight.

prepChecklist.text: Build a long sky bridge on both sides of your spawn point (700–1000 platforms)
Build a house for the Nurse nearby
Craft Super Healing Potions from Celestial Fragments
Drink Regeneration, Endurance, Lifeforce and Ironskin Potions
Drink Rage, Summoning and Wrath Potions for damage
Equip your best wings, unless you fly on a mount
Bring a Rod of Discord to teleport out of the Phantasmal Deathray
Equip a Frozen Shield for knockback immunity

strategies.text: Keeping a distance while dodging the Moon Lord's attacks is crucial. In particular, his Phantasmal Deathray should be avoided at all costs.
It is advisable to kill the eye on the head first.
Because of this attack it is a bad idea to keep the Moon Lord offscreen, as the player won't be able to see it coming.
The eyes will look at the player when preparing the attack, so you can predict it as well.
Running away in this case is better, as the True Eyes' Deathrays have much shorter reach compared to the Moon Lord's.
Using homing weapons or ammo like Chlorophyte Bullets allow the player to focus on dodging.
However, since the Moon Lord's eyes remove all debuffs when they close, the player will have to reapply them accordingly.
There are no important changes in these modes outside of increased damage.
The Soaring Insignia is by far the most important movement accessory after any wings in Expert and Master Mode.
The Daybreak is the strongest melee weapon available for the fight.
The Terra Blade and Flying Dragon are two other good options.
The Vortex Beater is the strongest gun available.
The Phantasm is a powerful option with the highest DPS in the stage.
The Nebula Blaze has good DPS and homing ability.
Since the Moon Lord is not immune to any debuffs aside from Shimmering and Confused, the Golden Shower can be used as a support weapon to lower the Moon Lords defense.
The Stardust Dragon Staff is generally the best minion that can be used against the Moon Lord, due to having the highest tracking distance.
If using all minion slots on the Stardust Dragon, the strongest whip-stacking combination consists of the Constellation, Kaleidoscope, Vulgar Display of Flower and Firecracker.

summon.text: After all three mechanical bosses have been defeated, Plantera's Bulbs will randomly spawn in the Underground Jungle (indicated by the status message "The jungle grows restless..."). These bulbs emit a faint pink light in dark areas and immediately summon Plantera nearby upon being destroyed, usually a fair distance off-screen.

suggestedEquipment.note: Of the whips this tip names, only the Firecracker is verified as obtainable before this fight.

prepChecklist.text: Fight in the Underground Jungle: anywhere else she enrages
Excavate a sizable arena before breaking her bulb
Clear the arena's background walls so her second form has less to hook onto
Don't dig out too much Mud: the arena must still count as Underground Jungle
Raise your maximum health to 500 with Life Fruit
Drink Ironskin, Endurance, Regeneration and Lifeforce Potions
Equip wings (or bring a mount) to dodge her attacks
Carry a stack of the best healing potion you have

strategies.text: In a large enough arena, distance can be maintained by constant movement.
In Plantera's second form, her only ranged attack consists of the Spores which are very easy to kill. This means that keeping a distance is key to avoiding damage.
Using a Gravitation Potion can help the player avoid damage from Thorn Balls laying on the ground, as the Thorn Balls obey gravity and fall to the floor.
Narrow passages slow Plantera as it takes more time for her to grip the surrounding terrain.
They simply wave themselves around at the end of their leash and get in the way of the player's attacks, making piercing weapons more valuable.
An arena with Teleporters will make the player escape from Plantera's attacks easily.
In these modes, Plantera's seed attacks can travel through blocks, and her tentacles can regrow.
This makes dodging the hooks important, either through removing blocks and walls from the arena or by moving down a long tunnel.
The True Excalibur has a very large range and can handle all phases of the fight fairly well due to its piercing.
The Mushroom Spear is easy to obtain and deals high damage, but is somewhat risky to use.
The Megashark with Crystal Bullets is the best gun at this stage.
The Chlorophyte Shotbow with Holy Arrows can be used to great effect.
The Venom Staff shoots multiple projectiles with piercing and Acid Venom.
The Rainbow Rod is both homing and piercing and deals a good amount of damage.
The Optic Staff and Blade Staff are the best options to summoners.
The Durendal is typically the best whip at this stage, while Firecracker deals higher damage when paired with Spider Staff in the first phase.

summon.text: The Queen Bee spawns upon breaking a Larva found inside Bee Hives in the Underground Jungle. She can also be summoned manually by using an Abeemination in the Jungle or Underground Jungle, at any time.

suggestedEquipment.note: Of the three weapons this tip names, only the Thorn Chakram is verified as obtainable before this fight.
This tip cautions that the Minishark is much less effective in Expert Mode unless paired with the Shark Tooth Necklace.
Of the two weapons this tip names, only the Flinx Staff is verified as obtainable before this fight.

prepChecklist.text: Fight in a Hive: it is already carved out and its honey pool regenerates health
Stay in the Underground Jungle: outside it she enrages
Place Wood Platforms about every 5 blocks
Clear Larvae near the arena so you don't summon a second Queen Bee
Equip a Bezoar to remove the Poisoned debuff
Drink Ironskin, Endurance and Regeneration Potions
Drink a Swiftness Potion to help dodge
Craft Bottled Honey from the Hive's honey

strategies.text: When she charges you, use platforms and/or a double jump or better to dodge upwards.
When she summons her Bees, use a weapon that can pierce targets and aim for her tail to stop the Bees the moment they spawn.
If any Bees manage to escape then use a sword with a large swing to clear them out.
If she's using the stinger-shooting phase, keep moving back and forth.
Getting hit by a stinger inflicts a Poisoned debuff that will last longer than running into Queen Bee, so make sure to dodge it.
Solid blocks can help to block the stingers.
Queen Bee is one of the few bosses that does not despawn when the player teleports away.
As the Queen Bee's health goes down, she will become a lot more aggressive, shooting more stingers and having much faster charges.
Successfully dashing into an enemy gives the player brief invincibility frames, so if timed right, the charge attacks can be completely neutralized.
Swords can be surprisingly effective, doing the most damage when the Queen Bee is releasing Bees or when charging you.
The Thorn Chakram, Trimarang, or Flamarang are good at killing the Queen Bee, due to their long range.
Bring along arrows that can pierce, such as Jester's Arrows or Unholy Arrows.
Note that the Minishark is much less effective in Expert Mode, especially in the latter stages of the battle, unless paired with the Shark Tooth Necklace.
Amethyst's homing ability is very helpful in this fight, being able to track the boss when she's dashing.
The Space Gun is a good weapon, especially when combined with Meteor armor. Its piercing effect will help with taking out the Bees.
Summoners should use the Flinx Staff or, preferably, the Vampire Frog Staff, together with one of the early whips.

summon.text: Queen Slime is summoned by using a Gelatin Crystal in The Hallow or Underground Hallow, at any time.

prepChecklist.text: Fight off the ground, on platforms, so her bouncing shots fall out of the arena
Fight her in daylight: her attacks can be hard to see at night
Bring weapons for her crowd of slimes and for reaching her winged form
Drink Regeneration, Endurance, Lifeforce and Ironskin Potions
Bring Gravitation Potions for dodging in her second phase
Drink a Swiftness Potion for mobility
Equip a Cobalt Shield (or an upgrade) against knockback
Carry a stack of the best healing potion you have

strategies.text: Killing the smaller slimes should be a priority during this phase, as they can quickly overwhelm the player.
Stay in the air using wings or mounts during her first phase, as many of her attacks cannot reach the player there.

During her second phase, the player should stay closer to the ground while occasionally luring her back up, as they can avoid many of her projectiles and minions due to their slow and predictable movement patterns.
Use several disconnected platforms, which can allow her minions to fall down and away from the fight.
Like most bosses, she is immune to lava, but her minions are not.
The player can run back and forth on the skybridge, jumping over projectiles, and Queen Slime will remain at roughly the same height the entire time, making targeting easier.
Queen Slime receives few changes in higher difficulties, beyond her minions having a faster attack rate and/or more projectiles.
When fighting her in higher difficulties, never remain directly above multiple Crystal Slimes.
The Shadowflame Knife is good because of its accuracy and bouncing projectiles, as well as the ability to inflict Shadowflame on multiple minions.
Yoyos are excellent in this fight due to their range and being easy to aim.
The Dart Pistol or Dart Rifle with Crystal Darts is useful due to its high damage output and its semi-homing ricochet ability, which can kill all of the nearby slimes that are summoned.
The Onyx Blaster is extremely powerful against Queen Slime when used with Crystal Bullets and supported with Ichor; however it has issues against the slimes.
The Life Drain is extremely useful for killing large groups of slimes with little aiming required.
The Crystal Storm also deals respectable DPS, especially if using the Blessed Apple mount in the second phase, as Queen Slime will ram into all of the projectiles.

The Firecracker has very high DPS when used as a main weapon if both the player and their minions are attacking the same target due to its ability of creating explosion on tagged enemies after minions hit them.

The Sanguine Staff is the best staff for this fight that doesn't require a whip, due to its high drop rate, damage, and aerial tracking, which allows it to consistently hit Queen Slime through out the second phase.

summon.text: Summoning Skeletron requires the player to speak to the Old Man at the Dungeon's entrance at night. Upon selecting the "Curse" option, he will turn into Skeletron. Skeletron can only be summoned once per night, as the Old Man will not respawn until dawn. Once Skeletron is defeated, the Old Man's curse will be lifted and he will no longer appear. Skeletron will thereafter only be summonable with the Clothier Voodoo Doll. Killing the Clothier at night with this accessory equipped will summon Skeletron.

prepChecklist.text: Plan the arena above the Dungeon roof or beside the Dungeon
Leave the Dungeon floor intact: edits there can stop the Cultists spawning later
Leave room to dodge the hands and vertical space for the head spin
Start early in the night: it enrages if not defeated by 4:30 AM
Drink Ironskin, Endurance and Regeneration Potions
Drink a Swiftness Potion to outrun the spinning attack
Drink a Featherfall Potion for air mobility
Bring a grappling hook to escape the head-spin attack

strategies.text: Attacking the hands first is advised, as destroying them both will make it very easy to dodge Skeletron for the rest of the battle. This is pretty much mandatory in Expert Mode, as Skeletron gains 25 defense for each hand it has alive.
Timing is key in order to defend from the hands: after dodging them, use piercing weapons to deal damage to both arms (and Skeletron's skull, if it happens to align with them).
Try to avoid staying above or far to one side of Skeletron for a long time.

After some time, Skeletron will use its spinning attack. Skeletron moves slowly, but they constantly follow the player. During this attack, Skeletron's defense is lowered to zero, but gains more attack. The player should use the fastest weapon at their disposal to deal a lot of damage. However, make sure to constantly move; if the player gets hit by it, they might get stunlocked and take a lot of damage.
Skulls are blocked by solid blocks, so a barrier between the player and Skeletron can let the player attack Skeletron using a yoyo with impunity.
In Expert Mode, if the player keeps moving in different directions, most of the homing skulls will miss.
During the fight, use your platforms to move in circles around Skeletron, flying over and around him and running underneath.
Yoyos such as Amazon are excellent against Skeletron, as they can deal high damage from a distance.
Flails can work due to their long range and ability to hit both the arms and head with a single attack.
The Demon and Tendon Bow are the most accessible bows at this stage. Use them with Frostburn Arrows and Jester's Arrows.
Bone Javelins are very effective due to their high damage and firing speed.
Amethyst's homing ability is very helpful in this fight, being able to track the boss while the player focuses on dodging.
The Crimson Rod is also a very effective method of damaging Skeletron, even allowing it to be used in combination with other weapons.
The Vampire Frog Staff, from the Blood Moon, and Imp Staff, from the Underworld, are the strongest minions available.
The strongest sentry available is Houndius Shootius. The Ballista Rod or Flameburst Rod are also helpful alternatives.

summon.text: Skeletron Prime can be summoned manually using a Mechanical Skull at night (from 7:30 PM to 4:30 AM).

suggestedEquipment.note: Of the two guns this tip names, only the Clockwork Assault Rifle is verified as obtainable before this fight.

prepChecklist.text: Build several suspended rows of platforms, each around 50 blocks long
Leave out a solid ceiling: it retreats a fair distance between spins
Summon it just after dusk (7:30 PM): it enrages at dawn
Equip Lightning Boots or other mobility accessories
Equip the Emblem of your class
Bring a way to inflict Ichor: it has high defense
Drink Swiftness, Ironskin and Regeneration Potions
Bring Greater Healing Potions

strategies.text: Although it is a little more time-consuming, focusing on the arms first is very rewarding.
A good idea is to focus on the Prime Laser first, as it is harder to dodge than the other limbs.
The inaccuracy and relatively low damage of the bombs makes the Cannon significantly less threatening than any of the other limbs.
Unhindered movement is crucial when Skeletron Prime's head starts spinning, as it deals double the regular damage.
Moving diagonally will make dodging the spinning head easier, as players can move faster in diagonal directions than in others.
If the player gets too far from the head while it is not spinning, it will fly back to the player extremely quickly, which can be difficult to dodge.
In this mode, the spinning head is much faster, and increases the further away the player is.
Its shots deal significant damage and it is Prime's most threatening limb in Expert mode.
The Hel-Fire, Amarok, or Yelets with the Yoyo Bag or Magic Yoyo Bag are all very strong choices.
The Chain Guillotines can be useful, thanks to their decent range and good damage.
The Onyx Blaster and Clockwork Assault Rifle are very powerful guns made even stronger with Crystal Bullets.
The Adamantite Repeater and Titanium Repeater are easy to obtain and do high damage, especially with Ichor Arrows.
The Lightning Strike is another strong weapon that attacks from above and does not get blocked by the hands.
The Meteor Staff is powerful and easy to craft, provided you have some leftover Meteorite Bars from Pre-Hardmode.
The Sanguine Staff is an extremely good summon weapon, due to its perfect tracking and high damage.
When using Summon weapons, it is recommended to use the targeting function to focus one arm at a time and reduce the threat Skeletron Prime poses.

summon.text: The Destroyer can be summoned manually using a Mechanical Worm at night (from 7:30 PM to 4:30 AM).

suggestedEquipment.note: Of the whips this tip names, only the Firecracker is verified as obtainable before this fight.

prepChecklist.text: Build a tall, wide arena with several rows of platforms
Summon it just after dusk (7:30 PM) for the most time before dawn
Bring a weapon that pierces or deals area damage
Leave flasks and debuff weapons at home: it is immune to debuffs
Equip a Cross Necklace (or an upgrade) against its laser barrage
Drink Regeneration, Endurance, Lifeforce and Ironskin Potions
Drink a Swiftness Potion for mobility
Carry a stack of the best healing potion you have

strategies.text: When avoiding The Destroyer, go up, not down.
Getting stuck under The Destroyer is extremely dangerous, so be sure to have an arena with platforms or good jump items.
Probes should be taken out as soon as possible, since they interfere with the fight and additionally serve as a steady source of Hearts.
Find a balance between damaging the worm and dealing with Probes to survive the fight.
For extra risk and reward, line up with the head (which has no defense) and fire down the length of its body.
Using the minimap to see where The Destroyer will surface can greatly help with dodging.
It is very important not to get touched by the head, as it can deal massive damage, bringing players from full health to zero in only two hits.
It is even more important not to get hit by the head as it can bring someone from a full, 400 health to 0 in one hit if they have less than 20 defense.
The Shadowflame Knife is a safe choice due to its long range as well as its ability to bounce off The Destroyer, hitting it and its Probes multiple times.
The Drippler Crippler and Dao of Pow can do significant damage across multiple body parts.
The Daedalus Stormbow is excellent against large bosses like The Destroyer.
The Onyx Blaster is the best gun available, and should be used with Exploding Bullets, or if another mech boss has been defeated, High Velocity Bullets.
The Life Drain is a great weapon for fighting The Destroyer, as it damages multiple segments at once, and can also strike down the Probes in a wide area.

The Meteor Staff deals extreme amounts of damage at a high speed and pierces many segments, but it burns through mana extremely quickly, so may perform inconsistently without a large supply of Greater Mana Potions.
The Firecracker and Cool Whip are the best whips for this fight, with the former multiplying enemy damage and the latter having a snowflake projectile that pierces multiple segments and hits Probes.
The Optic Staff and Sanguine Staff are the strongest minions available for this fight. Use these with the Firecracker.

summon.text: The Twins can be summoned manually using a Mechanical Eye at night (from 7:30 PM to 4:30 AM).

suggestedEquipment.note: Of the guns this tip names, only the Clockwork Assault Rifle is verified as obtainable before this fight.

prepChecklist.text: Build your arena in the sky: dodging most attacks needs vertical room
Summon them just after dusk (7:30 PM) for the most time before dawn
If another mechanical boss is down, eat Life Fruit from the Underground Jungle
Gear up for mobility: The Twins attack quickly
Equip the Emblem of your class
Bring Crystal or Ichor Bullets for guns, Holy or Ichor Arrows for bows
Drink Regeneration, Endurance and Ironskin Potions
Carry a stack of the best healing potion you have

strategies.text: It is a good idea to focus on one Eye, since the fight becomes easier if a single Eye has been defeated.
Spazmatism may be a better choice for defeating first, since its Cursed Flames are difficult to avoid without proper mobility equipment and buffs in its second phase.
Misdirecting Spazmatism's charges is easier than it sounds; by jumping as he slows down, he will charge over the player.
With wings it is possible to "zig-zag" up and down to dodge the lasers.
In its second phase, Retinazer can only attack the player if it has an unobstructed line of sight. Hiding in a box prevents it from dealing any damage.
A Gravitation Potion can be an excellent method of keeping distance from the Twins, allowing them to be attacked freely.
In Expert Mode, both Twins fire faster projectiles and have shorter cooldowns between attacks.
The Shadowflame Knife shoots very fast and deals a lot of damage per dagger.
Yoyos with the Yoyo Bag can be useful.
Guns such as the Megashark, Uzi, Onyx Blaster, Gatligator, and Clockwork Assault Rifle can be quite effective when paired with Ichor, Crystal, or Cursed Bullets.

The Daedalus Stormbow is a great bow, especially if combined with Ichor Arrows or Cursed Arrows, even better with a Magic Quiver and its upgrades, as they greatly increase arrow velocity, making it much easier to hit your shots.
The Crystal Serpent is one of the strongest weapons mages can use in early Hardmode.
The Spirit Flame's homing abilities and high damage allows the user to deal consistent damage.
The Firecracker increases damage output for minions, which is particular potent with ones that have high base damage, such as the Sanguine Staff or Abigail's Flower (if used all-in).
The Sanguine Staff has perfect tracking and high base damage, which make it a decent choice.

summon.text: The Wall of Flesh can be summoned by dropping a Guide Voodoo Doll into lava in The Underworld while the Guide is alive, which destroys the Guide Voodoo Doll and kills the Guide in the process.

suggestedEquipment.note: Of the two whips this tip names, only the Starcrash is verified as obtainable before this fight.

prepChecklist.text: Build a long bridge across the Underworld, about 1000 blocks or more
No bridge? Get Lava Waders (or an upgrade) or drink a Water Walking Potion
Reach 400 maximum health: Hardmode starts as soon as the Wall is defeated
Wear Hermes Boots or an upgrade: the Wall speeds up as it loses health
Fighting up close? Equip an Obsidian Shield against knockback
Drink Ironskin, Endurance and Regeneration Potions
Drink a Heartreach Potion to collect the Hearts from The Hungry and Leeches
Carry a stack of the best healing potion you have

strategies.text: The Wall will steadily move toward the player, so a safe distance should always be maintained.
At the start of the fight The Hungry should be focused on, preferably using piercing weapons or explosives.
The Hungry's damage and defense are boosted as the body takes damage, which will make them more difficult to kill if left for later.
Prioritize damaging the Eyes over the Mouth, as they have 0 / 6 defense compared to the Mouth's 12 / 18 defense.
The laser damage can be halved by building a bridge out of blocks instead of platforms, blocking the lower eye.
The Horrified debuff has the effect of instantly killing the player when they use a Teleporter, Magic Mirror/Ice Mirror or any of its upgrades, or a Recall Potion.
The Hungry will respawn quickly over time, making non-penetrating ammo less effective against the Wall.
Lasers can reach extremely fast firing rates, to the point where the lasers have no usable gap between them.
The Night's Edge has high DPS and a large area attack that make it the best melee option for this fight.
The Sunfury pierces with medium range, making it effective at both The Hungry and the boss.
The Hellwing Bow is the strongest bow available for this fight due to its rapid fire and piercing projectiles, with its accuracy downside mitigated by the Wall's huge size.
The Phoenix Blaster is the best gun available, being extremely consistent with its damage output, precise aim, and long range.

The Demon Scythe is without a doubt the strongest magic weapon against the boss, as its projectiles can hit the boss and The Hungry multiple times per projectile, especially if aimed vertically to hit multiple sections as the Wall moves.
The Aqua Scepter is one of the strongest mage weapons for this fight, due to its high DPS and piercing.
The best combination of minions involves two uses of the Vampire Frog Staff, two uses of the Flinx Staff, and one use of the Imp Staff.
The Spinal Tap or Starcrash are the best whips for the fight.
